title: Grit Grows
coreMove: Move from asking whether you have grit to asking which conditions are growing or shrinking it.
sourcePressure: Argue that grit is partly inherited but substantially shaped by experience.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating grit as either pure genetics or pure choice.

sourceAnchors.name: UK twin study
sourceAnchors.detail: Researchers using the Grit Scale with thousands of twins found heritability mattered, but environment still explained much of the difference.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The twin data narrows the claim: grit is influenced by inheritance, but it is not locked shut by it.

sourceAnchors.name: Dan Chambliss
sourceAnchors.detail: His own swimming career was limited by physical factors and poor coaching, showing nature and environment both matter.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Chambliss’s toes and coaches make the point cleaner than ideology can.
